title: The hopes and risks of bringing humanoid robots into our homes
source_used: PBS NewsHour page text (video description only)
key_facts: PBS NewsHour's Horizons programme ran a segment titled "The hopes and risks of bringing humanoid robots into our homes".
The page says humanoid robots now work in factories and assembly lines around the world and asks whether they will soon work in people's homes.
Horizons moderator William Brangham spoke with Aaron Ames of the California Institute of Technology about the robotic future.
Only the short description of the video was available; the interview itself was not read.
